coboundary.description: Coboundary operator delta_f for the general odd linear map f: g -> g. f(Z_j) = sum_i phi_{i,j} Z_i with p(Z_i) != p(Z_j). (delta f)(X,Y) = (-1)^{p(X)} [X, f(Y)] - (-1)^{(p(X)+1)*p(Y)} [Y, f(X)] - f([X,Y]). Entries stored for X <= Y in PBW order. Coefficients are linear in phi parameters (Scale A: natural). Graded antisymmetry: (delta f)(Y,X) = -(-1)^{p(X)p(Y)} (delta f)(X,Y).

references: Frappat et al. (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
